title: Ordinary coherent quotient reduction and its total tensor
statement: Let C be a category with topology J and essentially small in coefficient universe max(c,v,r). Let R be a commutative ring sheaf, B_n a tower of commutative ring sheaves, tau_n:B_(n+1) to B_n, and alpha_n:R to B_n with alpha_(n+1) followed by tau_n equal to alpha_n. From the constant system [def-pur-quotient-constant-system], these form the ring map Delta R to B_bullet. For a normalized scalar model S [def-coef-semilinear-system-models] of this map, define quotientReduction as the cochain functor of Delta followed by S.model.E. Define quotientTensor as the direct-sum total tensor of two such reductions. The ring map on (n,U) is exactly alpha_n(U). These are the unchanged existing constructions, independent of the flat-model existence theorem.
